Class NitriteQueryBinder

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.data.nitrite.runtime.query.NitriteQueryBinder
@Internal public final class NitriteQueryBinder extends Object
Shared JSON parameter-binding utilities used by both DefaultNitriteRepositoryOperations and NitriteQueryExecutor.

    • extractPlaceholderIndex

      @Nullable public static @Nullable Integer extractPlaceholderIndex(@Nullable @Nullable Object value)
      Extracts the numeric placeholder index from a "$mn_qp:N" string or a {"$mn_qp": N} map. Returns null if the value is not a placeholder.
      Parameters:
      value - the raw value to inspect
      Returns:
      the placeholder index, or null if the value is not a placeholder

    • resolveParameterValue

      public static Object resolveParameterValue(Object value, Object[] jsonParams, Map<String,Object> namedParameters, Function<Object,Object> toFilterValue)
      Resolves a raw filter or update value: replaces "$mn_qp:N" placeholders and ":"-prefixed named parameters with their actual values, converting through toFilterValue. Returns the value unchanged if it is not a placeholder.
      Parameters:
      value - the raw value
      jsonParams - positional JSON parameters
      namedParameters - named parameters
      toFilterValue - mapper used to normalize resolved values
      Returns:
      the resolved value

      Builds a named-parameter map from query bindings and method argument names. Values are converted via toFilterValue before being stored.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      the named parameter map
